features.title: Born with magic
features.text: Your bloodline determines your tradition, extra spells and blood magic effects. Choose a repertoire that fits a damage, healing, control or mixed role.

features.title: Sorcerous Potency
features.text: A generous supply of spell slots and a bonus to slotted spell damage or healing support powerful casting. Bloodline focus spells provide further signature abilities.

review.notes: Editorial assessment of the class framework and ordinary builds. Rules references support mechanics; scores remain judgments.

ratings.offense: 2–3.5 → 3–5. Offensive traditions and spell choices plus Sorcerous Potency enable exceptional area or burst damage.
ratings.defense: 1 → 2. Low HP and no initial armor training make positioning and protective spells important.
ratings.support: 3–5 → 3–5. Tradition and bloodline choices range from limited healing to excellent healing and control.
ratings.utility: 4 → 3–5. Tradition, repertoire and bloodline spells determine breadth outside combat.
ratings.difficulty: 2.5 → 3. Repertoire selection and resources require planning; casting itself is relatively flexible.
